announcements_window_order.name: announcements_window_order
announcements_window_order.value: "announcements"."starts_at" is null or "announcements"."ends_at" is null or "announcements"."starts_at" <= "announcements"."ends_at"

chat_messages_not_empty.name: chat_messages_not_empty
chat_messages_not_empty.value: "chat_messages"."body" IS NOT NULL OR "chat_messages"."chip_kind" IS NOT NULL

feedback_status_metadata_pair.name: feedback_status_metadata_pair
feedback_status_metadata_pair.value:
(
        ("feedback"."status" = 'declined' and "feedback"."declined_reason" is not null and btrim("feedback"."declined_reason") <> '' and char_length("feedback"."declined_reason") <= 1000 and "feedback"."shipped_version" is null)
        or
        ("feedback"."status" = 'shipped' and "feedback"."shipped_version" is not null and btrim("feedback"."shipped_version") <> '' and char_length("feedback"."shipped_version") <= 64 and "feedback"."declined_reason" is null)
        or
        ("feedback"."status" not in ('declined', 'shipped') and "feedback"."declined_reason" is null and "feedback"."shipped_version" is null)
      )

notification_digest_queue_deferred_idx.name: notification_digest_queue_deferred_idx
notification_digest_queue_deferred_idx.where: "notification_digest_queue"."delivered_at" is null and "notification_digest_queue"."deliver_after" is not null

portfolio_cash_movements_transfer_link.name: portfolio_cash_movements_transfer_link
portfolio_cash_movements_transfer_link.value:
("portfolio_cash_movements"."kind" in ('transfer_out','transfer_in'))
          = ("portfolio_cash_movements"."transfer_id" is not null and "portfolio_cash_movements"."counterpart_source_id" is not null)

portfolio_cash_movements_fee_standalone.name: portfolio_cash_movements_fee_standalone
portfolio_cash_movements_fee_standalone.value: "portfolio_cash_movements"."kind" <> 'fee' or ("portfolio_cash_movements"."transaction_id" is null and "portfolio_cash_movements"."dividend_id" is null)

portfolio_vault_transition_states_captur.name: portfolio_vault_transition_states_capture_target_attestation
portfolio_vault_transition_states_captur.value:
(
          "portfolio_vault_transition_states"."capture_vault_id" is null
          and "portfolio_vault_transition_states"."capture_media_attested_at" is null
          and "portfolio_vault_transition_states"."capture_media_attested_drive_connection_id" is null
        ) or (
          "portfolio_vault_transition_states"."capture_vault_id" is not null
          and "portfolio_vault_transition_states"."capture_media_attested_at" is not null
        )

portfolio_vault_transition_states_move_i.name: portfolio_vault_transition_states_move_in_receipt
portfolio_vault_transition_states_move_i.value:
(
          "portfolio_vault_transition_states"."move_in_vault_id" is null
          and "portfolio_vault_transition_states"."move_in_doc_version" is null
          and "portfolio_vault_transition_states"."move_in_completed_at" is null
        ) or (
          "portfolio_vault_transition_states"."move_in_vault_id" is not null
          and "portfolio_vault_transition_states"."move_in_doc_version" is not null
          and "portfolio_vault_transition_states"."move_in_completed_at" is not null
        )

portfolio_vault_transition_states_move_o.name: portfolio_vault_transition_states_move_out_receipt
portfolio_vault_transition_states_move_o.value:
(
          "portfolio_vault_transition_states"."move_out_vault_id" is null
          and "portfolio_vault_transition_states"."move_out_id" is null
          and "portfolio_vault_transition_states"."move_out_document_digest" is null
          and "portfolio_vault_transition_states"."move_out_document_set_hash" is null
          and "portfolio_vault_transition_states"."move_out_proof_public_key" is null
          and "portfolio_vault_transition_states"."move_out_completed_at" is null
        ) or (
          "portfolio_vault_transition_states"."move_out_vault_id" is not null
          and "portfolio_vault_transition_states"."move_out_id" is not null
          and "portfolio_vault_transition_states"."move_out_document_digest" is not null
          and "portfolio_vault_transition_states"."move_out_document_set_hash" is not null
          and "portfolio_vault_transition_states"."move_out_proof_public_key" is not null
          and "portfolio_vault_transition_states"."move_out_completed_at" is not null
        )

portfolio_vault_transition_states_receip.name: portfolio_vault_transition_states_receipt_lifecycle

portfolio_vault_transition_states_post_c.name: portfolio_vault_transition_states_post_commit_plan
portfolio_vault_transition_states_post_c.value:
(
        "portfolio_vault_transition_states"."move_out_post_commit_pending" and "portfolio_vault_transition_states"."move_out_completed_at" is not null
      ) or (
        not "portfolio_vault_transition_states"."move_out_post_commit_pending"
        and cardinality("portfolio_vault_transition_states"."move_out_post_commit_custom_asset_ids") = 0
        and "portfolio_vault_transition_states"."move_out_post_commit_last_attempt_at" is null
      )

portfolios_vault_alias_state.name: portfolios_vault_alias_state
portfolios_vault_alias_state.value: "portfolios"."vault_alias" is null or "portfolios"."vault_id" is not null

user_tax_settings_manual_default.name: user_tax_settings_manual_default
user_tax_settings_manual_default.value: ("user_tax_settings"."mode" = 'manual_per_trade') or ("user_tax_settings"."manual_default_amount_eur" is null and "user_tax_settings"."manual_default_rate_pct" is null)

users_paranoid_media_state.name: users_paranoid_media_state
users_paranoid_media_state.value:
("users"."privacy_mode" = 'normal' and "users"."paranoid_media_set" is null and "users"."paranoid_drive_attested_version" is null)
        or (
          "users"."privacy_mode" = 'paranoid'
          and "users"."paranoid_media_set" is not null
          and (
            "users"."paranoid_media_set" = array['server']::text[]
            or "users"."paranoid_media_set" = array['drive']::text[]
            or "users"."paranoid_media_set" = array['server', 'drive']::text[]
            or "users"."paranoid_media_set" = array['drive', 'server']::text[]
          )
          and ("users"."paranoid_drive_attested_version" is null or ("users"."paranoid_drive_attested_version" > 0 and "users"."paranoid_media_set" @> array['drive']::text[]))
        )

vault_blobs_portfolio_state.name: vault_blobs_portfolio_state
vault_blobs_portfolio_state.value:
("vault_blobs"."doc_kind" = 'portfolio' and "vault_blobs"."portfolio_id" is not null)
        or ("vault_blobs"."doc_kind" <> 'portfolio' and "vault_blobs"."portfolio_id" is null)

vaults_media_state.name: vaults_media_state
vaults_media_state.value:
(
          "vaults"."media" = array['server']::text[]
          or "vaults"."media" = array['drive']::text[]
          or "vaults"."media" = array['server', 'drive']::text[]
          or "vaults"."media" = array['drive', 'server']::text[]
        )
        and (
          ("vaults"."media" @> array['drive']::text[] and "vaults"."drive_connection_id" is not null)
          or (not "vaults"."media" @> array['drive']::text[] and "vaults"."drive_connection_id" is null)
        )

vaults_media_attestation_state.name: vaults_media_attestation_state
vaults_media_attestation_state.value:
(
          "vaults"."media_attested_at" is null
          and "vaults"."media_attested_drive_connection_id" is null
        ) or (
          "vaults"."media_attested_at" is not null
          and (
            (
              "vaults"."media" @> array['drive']::text[]
              and "vaults"."media_attested_drive_connection_id" is not null
              and "vaults"."media_attested_drive_connection_id" = "vaults"."drive_connection_id"
            )
            or (
              not "vaults"."media" @> array['drive']::text[]
              and "vaults"."media_attested_drive_connection_id" is null
            )
          )
        )
